product: Bajaj Majesty ICX 8 Plus Induction Cooktop
description: The Bajaj Majesty ICX 8 Plus is a single-zone induction cooktop with 8 preset Indian cooking menus (Roti, Dosa, Curry, Fry, Boil, Steam, Stir Fry, Deep Fry). Features voltage fluctuation protection and auto pan detection. The ceramic glass top is rated for 800°C thermal shock resistance.
price_reasoning: Bajaj official site ₹3,499 (MRP), Amazon ₹2,999 (selling price), Flipkart ₹2,799 (Big Billion Days, expired). Chose current Amazon price as most accessible.
manufacturer_info: Bajaj Electricals Ltd., part of the Bajaj Group. Established 1938. One of India's most trusted consumer electrical brands with products across lighting, fans, appliances, and consumer durables.
pros: 8 preset Indian cooking menus unique feature
Feather touch controls easy to clean
cons: Fan noise noticeable at high power
